_doc: CHOT CHONG CAO NHAM BIEN THE - cac truong hop luat tong quat CO Y khong bat.
Luat tong quat `is_sibling` trong scan_tgdd.py chi ket luan 'cao nham bien the' khi hai
model KHONG co thong so RAM/ROM khac nhau (`not has_distinct_specs`). Do la co y: hai SKU
that su khac nhau VAN co the trung gia mot cach hop le, nen khong duoc tu dong coi la nham.
Nhung co cap ma dung la nham that, va luat tong quat khong the biet. Vi du A08:
Hai dong nay khac nhau o 64 va 128 (deu la token RAM/ROM) nen `has_distinct_specs` = True,
nen `is_sibling` khong bat. Khi trang cua ban 64GB tra ve dung 5.590.000 thi do la gia cua
ban 128GB bi cao nham, khong phai ban 64GB tang gia.
TRUOC DAY con so nay nam THANG trong scan_tgdd.py:
Khai ra day de no la mot muc CO THE DOC VA RA SOAT, khong phai mot hang so lan trong code.
Them muc moi chi khi da doi soat that va ghi ro bang chung trong `reason`.

entries.reason: Trang cua ban 4GB/64GB doi luc tra ve dung RRP 5.590.000 cua ban Galaxy A08 4+128GB. Hai model khac nhau o token 64 va 128 nen luat is_sibling (von bo qua cap co RAM/ROM khac nhau) khong bat duoc. RRP chuan cua ban 64GB la 4.790.000 theo Master List data.js.
